content:
Alex: heads up — main pipeline turned red right after merging PR #4321 (small allocator tweak). Link: <https://ci.internal/runs/54321>
ci-bot: automatic alert: pipeline failed in step `gpu-smoke` (exit 137). run-id=54321
Alex: logs show `NativeOOM` in shard-3, but weirdly memory usage didn't spike in metrics. pasted a small tail:
Alex: ```
2026-03-18T04:22:11Z shard-3: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-18T04:22:12Z process killed by OOM killer
```
Alex: pinging @Maria who owns allocator changes
Maria: on it, grabbing logs. do we know which commit landed? @Jamal do you recall the hotspot in that PR?
Jamal: I skimmed it — it reduced batch padding and touched prefetch logic. could be a regression in prefetch -> double-alloc
SRE-Oncall: checking node flapping / eviction logs now, one node got restarted at 04:20, might correlate
Lina: can someone try a replay of the job with `BATCH_SIZE=1` to see if batchsize is the culprit? I can kick a rerun
Alex: yes please, Lina — rerun with BATCH_SIZE=1 and `PREFETCH=off` if possible
Lina: ok running `./ci/run_smoke.sh --run-id 54321 --env BATCH_SIZE=1 PREFETCH=off` — will update
ci-bot: rerun started: new-run=54322, queued on pool `dedicated-gpus`
Maria: also advise bisect: revert the allocator patch locally and run the smoke to confirm. if revert passes, we have a regression
Jamal: if it's node-specific, SRE can mark node as quarantine. SRE-Oncall — any signs of kernel OOM or docker OOM?
SRE-Oncall: kernel log shows `oom_reaper` invoked on node-7 around the same timestamp; also kubelet eviction for pods with high RSS
Alex: ok if rerun with smaller batch succeeds, we'll pick that as a short-term mitigation and open a revert PR
Lina: rerun finished — new-run=54322 -> failed again, same step `gpu-smoke`, same exit 137
Maria: thanks Lina. can you grab the container logs and `dmesg` output from node assigned for that run? tag me
Lina: uploaded logs: https://internal.artifacts/54322/logs.txt
Jamal: quick idea — could the prefetch thread be allocating on CPU pinned memory then copying? that can push device alloc timeline
Alex: agree. @Maria want me to revert PR on a temporary branch and run CI? I can open a hotfix PR if confirmed
Maria: please do the revert and run. also add an e2e with minimal padding to catch this in future
ci-bot: note: run 54321 had node restart, run 54322 used node-9 which had different kernel version
SRE-Oncall: node-7 shows `nvidia-persistenced` restart prior; I'm cordoning node-7 for investigation
Alex: thanks. summary: immediate mitigation = reduce BATCH_SIZE via config + cordon node-7. next steps: Maria to bisect/revert, Jamal to look at prefetch code, SRE to assess node stability
Lina: acknowledged — filing a follow-up thread in #incidents once we have root cause :eyes:
Maria: taking ownership of the revert and will update in ~30m
Alex: :thumbsup:
